in_marathi.name: Kansingh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kansingh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Kansingh is a name of Lord Kansa, the demon king of Mathura. He is the maternal uncle of Lord Krishna and is the king of Mathura. Kansa is famous for his cruel nature and his attempts to kill his nephew Krishna.
